calibrationPolicy.gutterLimit: Minimum measured alpha32 gutter is6.29984percent on Siam, so an8percent minimum across all25 is not claimed. Entire readable silhouettes fit; faint detached low-alpha noise requires separate camera framing metadata.

Selected full-body source identities and visible extremities were reviewed, but occluded far parts, detailed anatomy, texture, material, contact, exact grip and source dimensions remain unverified.

No borrowed sprite or exact source original pixels were imported as the generated candidate. Only image-generation outputs were imported. All10 quality edits used the image tool; no Python repainting, cropping, alpha cleanup or image editing was performed.

The first1290-check SOURCE run exposed a low-alpha framing defect. Connected-component camera metadata corrected it without changing PNGs. The final SOURCE and DIST art suites each passed1291 checks with236 captures and0 browser errors; seven SOURCE and18 DIST screenshots were directly inspected, while all236 capture hashes were compared. This verifies presentation/runtime integration, not source anatomy or1:1 fidelity.
